categories.name: Hidden Treasure Boxes
categories.description: All 39 invisible (hidden) treasure boxes, numbered 1-39 as in gf1 and the Secrets Guide; the Monstro Town treasure chest reports how many remain.

categories.name: Visible Chests, Treasure Rooms & Frog Coins
categories.description: Every visible chest and Frog Coin in each dungeon, plus the Belome Temple and Forest Maze treasure rooms.

categories.name: Star Pieces & Bosses
categories.description: All seven Star Pieces and every story boss, plus the optional Jinx (x3) and Culex fights.

categories.name: Sidequests, Minigames & Cameos
categories.description: Melody Bay cards, Midas River, Goomba Thumping, Yoshi races, Mine Cart, Beetle Mania, Musty Fears, Grate Guy's Casino, Bellhop, Link and Samus cameos.

categories.name: Ultimate Equipment & Party Growth
categories.description: Best weapon for each character (Lazy Shell, Sonic Cymbals, Star Gun, Drill Claw, Frying Pan), Super Jump rewards, every character level 30, 99 FP.

playthrough_notes: One playthrough covers all 99 achievements if you save before the mutually exclusive moments: Booster Tower curtains (Curtain Sneak vs Locomotive Loser: get caught and beat Booster, reload, then hide) and keep the Bright Card until the casino achievements are done. Hidden box #1 is only available during the first Mushroom Kingdom arrival; a missed box cannot be recovered on that file.
settings_notes: Use RetroArch with the Snes9x (current) core; commenters report Snes9x 2005/2010 and bsnes failing to trigger achievements, and one report of real hardware (FXPak Pro) not unlocking. Hardcore mode is compatible; the Super Jump achievements need stable 60 fps and low audio latency.

chapters.title: Prologue: Mario's Pad and Bowser's Keep
chapters.notes: Bowser fight: aim for the Kinklink chain. Use a Snes9x (current) core: older Snes9x/bsnes cores fail to trigger this set's achievements.

chapters.title: Mushroom Way and the Mushroom Kingdom
chapters.notes: MISSABLE: Hidden box #1 can only be taken while Toad runs to the Chancellor on the first arrival (jump on Toad's head, then onto the alcove above the door). Save first. Get Toadstool's ??? (between the fireplace and blue chair in her room) now; it is gone once Toadstool joins.

chapters.title: Bandit's Way, Croco and Mack
chapters.notes: Talk to the Toad before doing anything with the Wallet; selling it before talking to him is the missable path. Mack fight in the throne room gives the first (Blue) Star Piece.

chapters.title: Kero Sewers, Midas River and Tadpole Pond
chapters.notes: MISSABLE before Marrymore: reach Land's End from Kero Sewers via the Boos before knocking over the barrel. Start using Mario's Jump special every battle (Jump Man pops at about 50 uses).

chapters.title: Rose Way, Rose Town and the Forest Maze
chapters.notes: Forest Maze route: follow Geno; secret area directions 'left, left, straight, right' come from the man in the house on the cliff in Rose Town.

chapters.title: Pipe Vault and Yo'ster Isle
chapters.notes: Goomba Thumping needs 35+ points. Boshi race: betting on Yoshi and watching avoids the rhythm game.

chapters.title: Moleville and the Coal Mines
chapters.notes: Mine Cart under 2:16. Buy the Mystery Egg line from the Moleville rare seller in order. Warp Pipe: Fireworks -> Shiny Stone -> Carbo Cookie -> mole in the bucket; do not leave town or save mid-sequence.

chapters.title: Booster Pass and Booster Tower
chapters.notes: Curtain Sneak and Locomotive Loser are mutually exclusive on one run: save before the curtains, get caught and beat Booster, reload, then hide successfully.

chapters.title: Booster Hill and Marrymore
chapters.notes: MISSABLES: collect Toadstool's items fast and talk to Booster with 2 or fewer candle pairs lit; after the cake, leave by the north exit and refuse 4 times before leaving Marrymore.

chapters.title: Return to the Mushroom Kingdom and Star Hill
chapters.notes: Buy the Game Boy (Beetle Mania) from the kid in the Mushroom Kingdom inn for 500 coins. Bring a Yoshi Cookie for the Mukumuku on Star Hill.

chapters.title: Seaside Town, the Sea and the Sunken Ship
chapters.notes: MISSABLE: against Johnny keep at least one henchman alive so the fight never becomes a 1-on-1.

chapters.title: Seaside Town freed: Yaridovich and the shops
chapters.notes: MISSABLE: hand over the Star Piece the first time the fake Elder asks. MISSABLE: see Samus in the Mushroom Kingdom castle bedroom after Yaridovich and before climbing the Land's End cliff.

chapters.title: Land's End and Monstro Town
chapters.notes: Shogun: 3 consecutive jumps. Troopa climb under 12 seconds. Rest in Monstro Town to start the Musty Fears flag hunt.

chapters.title: Belome Temple
chapters.notes: Thwomp in Monstro Town knocks the temple key loose; pick the 'not accepting visitors' fortune to reach the treasure room.

chapters.title: Bean Valley and Grate Guy's Casino
chapters.notes: MISSABLE: do not sell or discard the Bright Card until the casino achievements are done. Star Egg: 100 total wins at Look the Other Way.

chapters.title: Nimbus Land
chapters.notes: MISSABLE: Dodo's pecking game for the Feather. After Valentina, visit the top of Booster Tower for the Valentina/Booster scene.

chapters.title: Barrel Volcano
chapters.notes: Room-by-room Frog Coins and Flowers; Hino Mart shops inside the volcano.

chapters.title: Optional side quests before Bowser's Keep
chapters.notes: Jinx x3, Culex, Super Jump rewards, Soprano Card, Cricket Jam, Yoshi-Ade, Shy Ranger (Feather), 99 FP, 100 Frog Coins held at once, every character at level 30.

chapters.title: Bowser's Keep
chapters.notes: Clear all six numbered doors (they hold three of the ultimate weapons). MISSABLE: Exor is fought once; knock out an eye and time Geno Whirl for 9,999.

chapters.title: The Gate and Smithy Factory
chapters.notes: POINT OF NO RETURN: beating Smithy rolls the ending. Have exactly 5 Fireworks purchases recorded beforehand for the star-shaped finale.
